COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
` WPMS No. 855 of 2024
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
 Mr. B.S. Koranga, Advocate for the
petitioner.
2. Mr. Devendra Pant, Brief Holder for
the State.
3. Petitioner has challenged a recovery
citation issued by Tehsildar, Ramnagar on
27.03.2024, whereby, a sum of Rs.
4,22,390/- has been sought to be
recovered from him.
4. Perusal of the record reveals that the
said recovery citation has been issued
pursuant to the judgment rendered by
District Consumer Disputes Redressal
Forum, Nainital on 28.06.2017.
5. Since, petitioner had a remedy of
filing appeal before the State Commission
under Consumer Protection Act, which he
has not availed, therefore, this Court
cannot interfere with the recovery citation
issued pursuant to the judgment dated
28.06.2017 rendered by competent court
of law. Thus, the relief as claimed cannot
be granted.
6. Accordingly, the writ petition fails and
is hereby dismissed.
 (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.)
 04.04.2024
U.U.
